name: computer-use-intel
description:
Computer Use for Intel (x86_64) Macs.

Aliases: @computer-use-intel, @computer-use, computer use, Computernutzung.

Drop-in replacement for the arm64-only bundled Computer Use plugin. Lets Codex control this Mac (mouse, keyboard, scrolling, screenshots, OCR / find-text-on-screen, Accessibility UI tree, menus, windows, clipboard) using cliclick, screencapture, osascript and native x86_64 Swift helpers (Vision OCR, Accessibility, CGEvent).

Use this plugin when the user asks to look at the screen, click, type, scroll, read on-screen text, or otherwise control local macOS apps on this Intel machine. Prefer the Accessibility tools (get_ui_elements / find_element / click_element / click_menu_item) over pixel/OCR clicking when possible.

interface.shortDescription: Control this Intel Mac: mouse, keyboard, screen, OCR, Accessibility
interface.longDescription: An x86_64 drop-in replacement for the arm64-only bundled Computer Use plugin. Exposes 52 tools to control the local Mac: screenshots (incl. Set-of-Marks annotated), mouse/keyboard with modifier holds and CGEvent scrolling, on-device Vision OCR (find text on screen), the macOS Accessibility UI tree (read elements, click buttons/menu items, set field values), window management, clipboard and pixel sampling. Built for Intel Macs where the official Computer Use helpers (arm64-only) cannot run.
